newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugoslav sugar beet, sunflower, soybean crops up.
newsitem.headline: Yugoslav sugar beet, sunflower, soybean crops up.

text.p: Yugoslavia's 1996 sugar beet output jumped 41 percent over last year to 2.4 million tonnes, the Yugoslav Statistics Office said on Wednesday.

According to the office's preliminary data, average yield on the 70,000 hectares under sugar beet was 34.35 tonnes per hectare. The sugar beet acreage was raised by around 8,000 hectares compared to last year.
The report said the sunflower crop would reach 389,000 tonnes this year, an increase of 32 percent on 1995.
Sunflower acreage was increased by 34,000 hectares to around 204,000 hectares in 1996.
Average sunflower yield improved by eight percent to 1.9 tonnes per hectare.
Soybean production also jumped 43 percent over last year to around 153,000 tonnes, with an average yield per hectare of 2.10 tonnes.
An additional 21,000 hectares were planted with soybean this year, raising the total area under the crop to 73,000 hectares.
